title: Change the details on a vehicle registration
summary: Update the details linked to your vehicle registration at a Service NSW Centre.
intro:
Details linked to your vehicle registration can be updated at a Service NSW Centre. These include:

It's important to change your details before renewing your vehicle's registration to make sure that an appropriate inspection is conducted, and that you are charged the correct fee.

Note: If you're only changing a courtesy name, or usage such as private, business or pensioner, you may be eligible to do so by calling 13 77 88.
what_you_need: The PDF form 'Change of Records' (unless only changing a courtesy name).
Evidence of registration under a business name (if applicable).
Business identification details (if the vehicle is registered under a business).
A receipt or notice of disposal, signed by the seller and showing the correct date (if changing the date of purchase or disposal).

how_to_steps.text: Download and complete the Change of Records – PDF (if applicable).
Make sure you have all the required documentation.
Visit a service centre and lodge your application.

faqs.q: Do I need to change my details before renewing my registration?
faqs.a: Yes, it is important to change your details before renewing your vehicle's registration to ensure the correct inspection is conducted and the correct fee is charged.

faqs.q: How can I change a courtesy name or usage (like private, business, or pensioner)?
faqs.a: You may be eligible to change a courtesy name or usage by calling 13 77 88.
